_doc: Rules are data. Each maps to a deterministic check in agentic_gate/checks.py. 'block' fails the required status check; 'warn' is reported. 'waivable' = may be break-glassed with an audited reason.

rules.title: No secrets or card numbers in the diff
rules.why: Credentials/PANs in git are a reportable incident the moment they merge.
rules.fix: Remove the value, rotate it if real, use the secrets manager / test PANs from the PSP sandbox.

rules.title: No card/token fields written to logs
rules.why: PCI scope creep: logs are the most common accidental cardholder-data sink.
rules.fix: Log an opaque reference id instead of the field.

rules.title: Respect component import boundaries
rules.why: Cross-boundary imports are how a UI change ends up coupled to payment internals.
rules.fix: Go through the published API of the other component, or request a boundary change in the catalog.

rules.title: Source change ships with tests; Tier 0 needs a contract test
rules.why: An LLM reading a diff is not evidence that behaviour is preserved. A test is.
rules.fix: Add/adjust tests. Tier 0: add a test under a 'contract' path covering the changed interface.

rules.title: Tier 0/1 changes roll out behind a flag; Tier 0 canary <= 5%
rules.why: Sev-1 blast radius is set by how fast a bad change reaches 100% of traffic.
rules.fix: Wrap behaviour in a feature flag; set rollout.canary_pct <= 5 for Tier 0.

rules.title: Tier 0 needs a human CODEOWNER sign-off on risk
rules.why: Humans accept risk on money movement; they do not hunt for misses (gates do that). No model can be the approver.
rules.fix: Request approval from the component owner listed in the catalog.

rules.title: Agent run telemetry is complete and canonical
rules.why: Without outcome and time data we cannot tell which controls earn their keep.
rules.fix: Use a canonical workflow id and report time_impact_mins.

judge._doc: LLM judge earns authority from a measured golden-set score. Below either bar it is advisory only. It can NEVER satisfy OWN-001/TEST-001, override a block, or be the sole control on Tier 0/1.
